answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity and commit to an epoch-specific polynomial whose secret shares support rate-limited proofs. If an agent repeats a nullifier in duplicate messages, the verifier combines the exposed Shamir shares to recover the private key and immediately slash the bonded collateral. Domain tags such as saffron, mirror, and prism must be cryptographically separated so proofs cannot be replayed across epochs or contexts.
